formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signature lets anyone call permit() on Linea USDC, which sets the owner's USDC allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it (EIP2612._permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).
After that, the spender can move up to `value` USDC from the owner with transferFrom.
The signature works only until `deadline` (require(deadline >= now)). It uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so earlier unused permits with that nonce stop working.
formats.shown: The intent "Authorize spending of tokens", then the spender as a raw address, the max spending amount in USDC ("Unlimited" at or above 2^255), the expiry date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no test case, so no rendering of the amount, the Unlimited threshold or the date is checked.
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: "cases: 0 (no tx)" for Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline).
findings.fix: Add EIP-712 test cases for Linea USDC permit: one with a finite value, and one with value 2^256-1 that renders "Unlimited".

findings.title: Permit domain name "USDC" comes from storage set in initializeV2, so the source cannot confirm it.
findings.evidence: FiatTokenV2.initializeV2: `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = EIP712.makeDomainSeparator(newName, "2");` newName is an argument given at upgrade time. descriptor.json domain: {"name": "USDC", "version": "2"}. The version "2" and the type string match PERMIT_TYPEHASH's comment "Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)".
findings.fix: Check the on-chain DOMAIN_SEPARATOR of 0x1762…e1ff against keccak of the domain with name "USDC", version "2", chainId 59144.

findings.title: The Permit intent does not say that the signed value replaces any existing USDC allowance for the spender.
findings.evidence: EIP2612._permit: `_approve(owner, spender, value);` sets the allowance and does not add to it. Descriptor intent: "Authorize spending of tokens".
findings.fix: Optionally add an interpolatedIntent like "Allow {spender} to spend {value}"; the deterministic checks already cover the missing interpolatedIntent.
